Warm regards, Customer Support Team

Final Demand Notice for Overdue Loan Repayment
Dear Mr. Kumar, We regret to inform you that your business loan has not been repaid as per the agreed terms.

PLEASE SUBMIT BY WITHIN 7 DAYS OF THIS NOTICE

Account Details
Recovery & Collections Department | 45 Anna Salai, Chennai - 600002 | recovery@abccommercialbank.com

Consequences of Non-Payment
Failure to settle the due amount within the stipulated timeframe will result in severe repercussions, including reporting your default to credit bureaus, adding further penalties and interest, initiating legal proceedings, and enforcing rights over any collateral or guarantees.
• Report your default to all credit bureaus, severely damaging your credit score for years.
• Add further penalties, interest, and recovery charges to your balance.
• Initiate legal proceedings and recover the amount, along with all legal costs, from you.
• Enforce our rights over any collateral or guarantees securing this loan.

If you fail to do so, we will:
(cid : [REDACTED_PIN_CVV]) Report your default to all credit bureaus, severely damaging your credit score for years; (cid : [REDACTED_PIN_CVV]) Add further penalties, interest, and recovery charges to your balance; (cid : [REDACTED_PIN_CVV]) Initiate legal proceedings and recover the amount, along with all legal costs, from you; (cid : [REDACTED_PIN_CVV]) Enforce our rights over any collateral or guarantees securing this loan. Do not mistake our patience for weakness. This matter is now beyond reminders. Your credibility as a borrower is at stake, and the consequences of continued default will be entirely your own doing. Pay immediately via the bank's payment portal or at your nearest branch. Do not contact us again without payment.
Regards, Suresh Menon Recovery Manager ABC Commercial Bank Ltd.

Thank you for your cooperation
ABC Commercial Bank Ltd

Final Request for Repayment of Overdue Loan No. LN-2026-004581
Dear Mr. Kumar, We hope this message finds you well. We understand that circumstances can change, and we are here to help you get back on track with your loan repayment.

PLEASE SUBMIT BY WITHIN 7 DAYS OF THE DATE OF THIS NOTICE

Loan Details
Recovery & Collections Department | 45 Anna Salai, Chennai - 600002 | recovery@abccommercialbank.com

The facts are as follows:
You borrowed this money, accepted the terms, and are obligated to repay it. We are here to assist you in resolving this matter promptly.

If you fail to do so, we will:
• Report your default to all credit bureaus, which may severely impact your credit score for years.
• Add further penalties, interest, and recovery charges to your balance.
• Initiate legal proceedings to recover the amount, along with all legal costs, from you.
• Enforce our rights over any collateral or guarantees securing this loan.

Important information about your loan obligations
Please pay the full amount of Rs. 4,88,250 within 7 days of the date of this notice. You can make the payment via the bank's payment portal or at your nearest branch.

Thank you for your cooperation
ABC Commercial Bank Ltd
Recovery & Collections Department
ABC Commercial Bank Ltd.
